parts.name: Cabinet Door (Lower)
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower cabinet door of the storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment and protects stored items from dust and view.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door (Upper)
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper cabinet door of the storage cabinet, made of MDF with a similar finish to the lower door.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper storage compartment and conceals its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet, made of plywood for rigidity and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the doors and shelves, maintaining the overall shape and stability of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items in the lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space and supports stored items in the middle section.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items in the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move.
